summary: Five games were played on Saturday, and Miami scored a night-high 137 points as Giannis Antetokounmpo had 34 points, 14 rebounds and 8 assists in a 20-point win over Detroit, the largest margin of the night. Tyrese Proctor posted 24 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists in Cleveland's 127-117 win over Dallas despite 34 from Kyrie Irving. Denver and Chicago both won on the road, at New Orleans and Minnesota.

games.headline: Nuggets pull away from Pelicans with 11-0 run
games.story: Denver went ahead for good at 9-7 early in the first quarter, but New Orleans trailed only 86-82 after three. The Nuggets then scored 11 straight points across the end of the third and start of the fourth to lead 95-82, and pushed the margin to 15 at 102-87. Nikola Jokić had 26 points on 9-of-14 shooting with 10 assists and 8 rebounds, Jamal Murray added 23 points and 9 assists, and Christian Braun had 17 points and 4 steals. Zion Williamson scored 24 for the Pelicans, who were without Dejounte Murray and Trey Murphy III.

games.headline: Proctor's triple-double carries Cavaliers past Dallas
games.story: The teams were tied 33-33 after one quarter before Cleveland went ahead for good at 45-44 midway through the second, and a 10-0 run later in the quarter helped it lead 71-53 at halftime. Dallas scored 11 straight points to get within 95-85 late in the third, but the Cavaliers opened the fourth with 8 in a row to lead 113-91. Tyrese Proctor had 24 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists, Mario Hezonja scored 22 on 9-of-12 shooting and Thomas Bryant added 19 points and 11 rebounds for Cleveland, which was without James Harden, Donovan Mitchell and Evan Mobley. Kyrie Irving scored 34 with seven 3-pointers for the Mavericks.

games.headline: Giannis scores 34 as Heat run past Pistons
games.story: Detroit scored 39 in the first quarter and led 41-37 early in the second, but Miami went ahead for good at 49-47 and led 68-60 at halftime. The Heat outscored the Pistons 35-26 in the third and led by as many as 20 in the closing minutes. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 34 points on 13-of-17 shooting with 14 rebounds and 8 assists, and Klay Thompson made six 3-pointers for 26 points in 20 minutes. Cade Cunningham scored 33 for Detroit, making all 14 of his free throws, and the Pistons were without Jalen Duren.

games.headline: Coward and Grizzlies roll past Nets by 19
games.story: Memphis went ahead for good at 8-7 in the opening minutes and led 38-23 after the first quarter. The Grizzlies outscored Brooklyn 16-1 late in the third to turn an 85-77 lead into a 101-78 cushion, and they led by as many as 26 in the fourth. Cedric Coward had 23 points, 12 rebounds and four 3-pointers, Taylor Hendricks scored 22 on 9-of-13 shooting, and five Grizzlies scored at least 15. Julius Randle led the Nets with 22 points and Day'Ron Sharpe had 16 points and 11 rebounds; Brooklyn did not have Michael Porter Jr.

games.headline: Bulls hold off Timberwolves rally, win by 11
games.story: Chicago took the lead for good at 5-4 and led 29-17 after the first quarter and 58-45 at halftime. Minnesota scored 13 straight points in the third to cut a 65-51 deficit to 65-64, but the Bulls led 88-80 after three and by as many as 16 in the fourth. Norman Powell scored 24, Matas Buzelis had 18 points and 9 rebounds, and Buddy Hield and Tre Jones added 16 each. Ayo Dosunmu scored 24 for the Timberwolves, who were without Anthony Edwards, and LaMelo Ball made 4 of 19 3-point attempts.
